summary.text: Keresa Richardson is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 61 who has represented the district since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a business owner and the CEO of Lawton Group.

paragraphs.text: Keresa Richardson was born in Denison, Texas, and earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 1979 and a graduate degree from Oklahoma State University.
Her career experience includes working as a business owner.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, her campaign said she and her husband founded their first business 40 years ago and that she is CEO of Lawton Group.
Richardson took office on January 14, 2025, succeeding Frederick Frazier.
She advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Brittany Black and the Green Party's Anissa Chilmeran in the general election.
Her survey listed securing the border, lowering property taxes and election integrity as her key messages, and named parental rights in education as a policy interest.
